viktor-jirsa.reason: All four papers are directly authored by or heavily associated with Viktor Jirsa. The sanz-leon-2013 paper is the foundational The Virtual Brain publication where Jirsa is senior author. The other three are co-authored papers on whole-brain modeling, neural mass models, and connectivity dynamics - all central to Jirsa's research contributions.

whole-brain-simulators.reason: The sanz-leon-2013 paper is the primary source for The Virtual Brain, one of the major whole-brain simulation platforms. It details the TVB platform architecture, neural mass modeling approach, and connectome-based whole-brain methodology.
